description: This PHP file defines a controller class ReturnReason within the Opencart admin module, responsible for managing return reason tasks such as generating lists, retrieving, and clearing JSON files related to return reasons in an OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: ReturnReason
classes.description: Controller class managing return reason related tasks such as generating task lists, exporting, and clearing return reason data for different stores and languages within the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes return reason tasks across stores and languages by creating scheduled tasks for each store-language pair.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates a JSON file containing return reasons for a specified store and language.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes generated JSON return reason files for all store-language combinations.
